title: Runtime observations refused by a transient Engram store state (projection repair) exhaust 8 retries in about 4 minutes and are lost for good
outcome: A prepared runtime observation that has been durably retained locally remains pending when delivery is refused by a typed temporary Engram store condition. The host retries the same immutable report until the store is ready, keeping the original source attribution and its checks eligible for credit. A refusal before preparation remains subject to the bounded closing-capture budget, with a readable terminal notice on exhaustion.
acceptance: After exact local readback of a prepared report, typed temporary store refusals during delivery (including projection_repair_required, work_projection_invalid, and control_startup_busy) preserve the immutable request and the prior ambiguity budget, with a deduplicated redacted recovery notice. The report can survive a repair window of at least one hour. Permanent delivery refusals and exhausted closing preparation end with readable notices. A locally durable prepared predecessor releases successor admission while its delivery is pending.

Deterministic behavioural tests drive a prepared report through typed temporary store refusals beyond the former eight-attempt backoff, then a ready store, and show that the same observation reaches the producer once with its original attribution and checks eligible for credit. A named-root successor starts while that prepared report waits. Separate cases show that closing preparation still exhausts its fixed budget and permanent delivery refusal settles with a readable notice.
The review pair is clean and the full gate passes on the exact landed input.
